title: Phoscrete Concrete Repair Materials
description_text:
Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the New York City Procurement Policy Board Rules, the New York City Department of Transportation (NYCDOT) intends to enter into sole source negotiations with Phoscrete Corporation for an agreement to purchase Phoscrete Magnesium-Phosphate-Cement concrete repair materials for a term of three (3) years with an option to renew for two (2) years.
NYCDOT has determined that Phoscrete Corporation is the sole provider of Phoscrete Magnesium-Phosphate-Cement concrete repair materials. The products are proprietary and are sold by Phoscrete Corporation directly to end users.  No alternate source exists to provide these products.

On August 19, 2026, the ACCOs office determined, in accordance with Section 3-05(b) of the Procurement Policy Board Rules, that Phoscrete Corporation, is the only entity authorized to manufacturer and has controlling source of Phoscrete, Therefore, Phoscrete Corporation is the sole source provider for these products.

Any firm that believes it is qualified to provide these products is invited to do so by responding to the RFI EPIN: 84127Y0884 in PASSPort no later than October 5, 2026, by 2:00 pm.  Any questions should be directed to the authorized agency contact, Kathy Cornwall-Wilson (kcornwallwilson@dot.nyc.gov), at 212-839-9276.
